maddeler.e:
أتحارب (form VI)
# أَتَحَارَبُ (ʔataḥārabu) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.ra.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
# أَتَحَارَبَ (ʔataḥāraba) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.ra.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
# أَتَحَارَبْ (ʔataḥārab) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.rab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
